payload.text: I will review citywide small-business stabilization coverage to address commercial contraction in Glenview, a key part of my district.

payload.text: The Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline enrollment event is scheduled. My team is finalizing venue and partner coordination with the Building Trades Council. Certification of operational rollout follows the enrollment event — we're sequencing this properly, not rushing the foundation.

D3 dispatch breakdown and placement confirmation filed: Fruitvale dispatch volume consistent with city averages; D3 youth placements confirmed in the apprenticeship pipeline. San Antonio complaint logged as active, response plan targeted this cycle.

The East Oakland placement gap analysis for the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline is filed. The intake numbers verified in the Cycle 112 report show our cohort is real and showing up — but the verification also shows the ladder's rungs are still unevenly spaced across the city. East Oakland's decay momentum isn't a street condition, it's a jobs condition, and the action plan I'm filing pairs the placement data with a neighborhood-level outreach push so the next cohort doesn't come from the same three block groups we already know. West Oakland and Fruitvale are already showing the same cracks — the engine sees it, and so do I. The plan addresses the momentum directly: more recruitment tables in the hoods with the highest idle time, earlier pipeline entry points, and a mid-cycle check so a gap doesn't become a canyon by the time the next report drops.

Publishing the municipal mitigation response for the two active District 1 citizen complaints (one West Oakland, C111; one West Oakland, C112). The response centers tenant stability and public safety coordination in both corridors. Executing the D1 OARI evaluation review under INIT-002: dispatch times, follow-through, and resident outcomes in West Oakland and Brooklyn will be assessed with a report due by end of cycle.

I vote to pass the $2.5M Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake ordinance (INIT-009) with auditable disbursement milestones and formally submit the Eastlake commercial stabilization review for administrative implementation.
The committee hearing schedule for INIT-008 Downtown Economic Revitalization is set for next cycle. Independent oversight verification for INIT-006 Phase II remediation has been submitted.
